Author: Deepak Verma

High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc:131933
Court No. - 67
Case :- Criminal Misc. Bail Application No. - 26986 of 2024
Applicant :- Smt Maya
Opposite Party :- State of U.P.
Counsel for Applicant :- Amit Saxena,Priya Saxena
Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Satish Chandra Tiwari
Hon'ble Deepak Verma,J.
1.

entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Counter affidavit has been filed today in the Court by informant's counsel, is taken on record.

2. Heard learned counsel for the applicant, learned counsel for the informant, learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.
3.

The instant bail application has been filed on behalf of the applicant with a prayer to release her on bail in Case Crime No. 146 of 2024, registered under Sections 498A, 304B I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of DP Act, Police Station Kunwargaon, District Badaun during pendency of the trial.

4. Prosecution story is that applicant's son was married with informant's daughter four years ago,
thereafter, members of in-laws demanded for additional dowry and on account of non-fulfillment of Smt Maya vs State Of U.P. on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13541572/
1 the same, the in-laws committed murder of the informant's daughter.
5.

entities.text: Smt Maya vs State Of U.P.
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the present case due to ulterior motive.
Applicant is mother-in-law of the deceased.
Cause of death of the deceased is due to asphyxia as a result of ante mortem hanging.
Except ligature mark on neck, there is no other mark of injury found over the body of the deceased.
Applicant has no concern with the alleged incident.
Applicant has been implicated being mother-in-law of the deceased.
Allegation alleged in FIR regarding demand of dowry is totally false and baseless.
Applicant has no previous criminal history.
The applicant is languishing in jail since 09.06.2024.

In case, the applicant is released on bail, she will not misuse the liberty of bail and co-operate in trial.
6.

Learned counsel for the informant has vehemently opposed the bail prayer of the applicant and submitted that applicant is mother-in-law of the victim and all in-laws members are residing in the same house, hence, applicant is responsible for death, as such, applicant is not entitled to be enlarged on bail.

7. Considering the material available on record and keeping in view the nature of the offence,
argument advanced on behalf of the parties, evidence on record regarding complicity of the accused and without expressing any opinion on the merits of the case, the Court is of the view that the applicant has made out a case for bail.
The bail application is allowed.

8. Let the applicant, Smt. Maya, who is involved in the aforesaid case crime, be released on bail on her furnishing a personal bond and two sureties each in the like amount to the satisfaction of the court concerned subject to following conditions.
Further, before issuing the release order, the sureties be verified.
i. The applicant shall not tamper with the prosecution evidence by intimidating/ pressurizing the witnesses, during the investigation or trial.
ii. The applicant shall cooperate in the trial sincerely without seeking any adjournment.
iii. The applicant shall not indulge in any criminal activity or commission of any crime after being released on bail.
9. In case of breach of any of the above conditions, it shall be a ground for cancellation of bail.

Order Date :- 14.8.2024 Nitin Verma  Smt Maya vs State Of U.P. on 14 August, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/13541572/
